items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued August 22 at 9:42AM AKDT until August 22 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
The fog layer over Fairbanks has begun to dissipate. There may be a
few isolated areas of dense fog around town, but those too will
continue to dissipate through the next couple of hours.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued August 22 at 8:49AM AKDT until August 22 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 40 mph.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 22 at 5:26AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
A Bering Sea low will move into the Gulf of Anadyr then the
Chukchi Sea on Monday. South-southwest winds will increase water
levels to around 1 to 3 feet above the normal high tide line
during the Monday and Tuesday high tides in the Seward Peninsula.
Water levels around 2 to 4 feet above the normal high tide line
are possible from Kotzebue to Kivalina. There is still quite a bit
of uncertainty with the exact water level heights and they will
be monitored over the next few days.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued August 21 at 11:39PM AKDT until August 25 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 1 to 3 feet above the normal high tide
line expected.

* WHERE...Yukon Delta Coast.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Sunday to 4 AM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur.

water level forecast may change slightly this weekend.
